project.name: IPower Investments CRM – change round 2
project.purpose: Bring the running app (built from fl_crm_demo.json + Changes.txt items 4–10) in line with the updated owner documents of 19 Oct 2026. Lists only what is still missing or conflicts; items already built are listed under already_done so they are not rebuilt.
project.baseline: main @ 39ff618 plus uncommitted work of 19 Oct 2026 (paid to company, receipt deposit status, collected/deposited by, commission hidden)

rules_for_builder: Plan first: before each phase, list the files and migrations it touches and confirm in chat. Ask when a requirement is ambiguous; do not pick silently.
Answer open_decisions before building the items that depend on them (each item lists depends_on).

Targeted changes only; don't rewrite working modules. Keep the existing look (shadcn/ui, Tailwind) and IPower branding – screens in the PDF say 'ABC Financial Services' and 'FL_CRM' only as sample text.
Pinned: Next.js 15, React 19, Prisma 6.19.3 (not 7/8), TanStack Table v8, exceljs 4.4.0. Forms submit with submitKeepingValues (src/lib/form.ts).
Prisma enum changes: migrate dev --create-only, review SQL, then migrate deploy. Stop the dev server before prisma generate on Windows.
Day Book is immutable: every money move is a DayBookEntry via src/lib/posting.ts; corrections are reversals; closed days refuse writes (refuseOnClosedDay / guarded()).
Server actions return ActionResult {ok, error}; permissions via authorize()/canActOn/ownerScope; list pages and their Excel/PDF export share one loader (see src/lib/lists.ts, src/lib/renewals.ts).
Tests write to DATABASE_URL: run vitest only on a scratch DB (createdb flcrm_check → migrate deploy → db:seed → pnpm test → dropdb). Never touch .env or secrets without asking.

Each phase ends with: typecheck + lint clean, vitest green on scratch DB, a headless browser check of the new screens, app/CLAUDE.md business rules updated, then check in with the owner. Commit/push only when asked.

roles.superadmin: Owner – everything; only role that sees Profit and Loss; approves expenses above ₹5,000 and Admins' own; sets approval limits; confirms money returned to owner; can create Admins and Super Admins
roles.admin: Approves ₹2,001–₹5,000 (not own), closes Day Book, cancels receipts/invoices/owner-paid slips, adds users as User or Admin, edits Settings (fields, products, reminders, payment modes), confirms family groups, deletes any quotation
roles.user: Daily work: leads, follow-ups, quotations, renewals, receipts, E-Sevai, wallet upload, expenses, Day Book entries; cancels own expenses; deletes own quotations; can suggest family groups; raises tickets and closes own
roles.note: Three roles only – no Manager role. Aadhaar and PAN masked for every role.

open_decisions.spec_says: Commission module, rates, TDS and commission-received upload are removed from v2. P&L income = service charges (EB, PAN, certificates) + 'Other income (entered in Day Book)' − expenses.
open_decisions.app_does: Records commission on receipts and shows insurer/MF commission as P&L income (Super Admin only), per owner choice on 19 Oct.
open_decisions.question: Drop commission from P&L and add an 'Other income' Day Book entry instead, keep commission, or both?
open_decisions.decision: Owner 19 Oct 2026: remove commission from P&L (page, export, monthly P&L). Commission is then shown nowhere; recording it on receipts can stay in the database. P&L income = service charges + other income (see C39).

open_decisions.spec_says: Bill date = entry date (today); transaction date may be up to 10 days earlier (rule #19).
open_decisions.app_does: Change 10: any user may back-date the bill date to any day after the last closed day; transaction date is free.
open_decisions.question: Switch to the v2 rule (bill date locked to today, txn date ≤ 10 days back) or keep back-dating?
open_decisions.decision: Owner 19 Oct 2026: keep the receipt dates as built (Change 10) – do not apply the 10-day rule.
